content: द्रव्यम् .²1 A thing, substance, object, matter; the whole creation (अधिभूत); द्रव्यक्रियाकारकाख्यं धूत्वा यान्त्यपुनर्भवम् <ls>Bhāg. 12. 6. 38</ls>. .²2 The ingredient or material of anything. .²3 A material to work upon. .²4 A fit or suitable object (to receive instruction <ab>&c.</ab>); द्रव्यं जिगीषुमधिगम्य जडात्मनोऽपि <ls>Mu. 7. 14</ls>; see अद्रव्य also. .²5 An elementary substance, the substratum of properties; one of the seven categories of the Vaiśeṣikas; (the {%dravyas%} are nine:-- पृथिव्यप्तेजोवाग्वाकाशकालदिगात्ममनांसि); one of the six of the Jainas (जीव, धर्म, अधर्म, पुद्गल, काल and आकाश). .²6 Any possession, wealth, goods, property, money: षड् द्रव्याणि-- ‘मणयः पशवः पृथिवी वासो दास्यादि काञ्चनम्’; उपार्जनं च द्रव्याणां परिमर्दश्च तानि षट् <ls>Mb. 12. 59. 64</ls>; तत् तस्य किमपि द्रव्यं यो हि यस्य प्रियो जनः <ls>U. 2. 19</ls>. .²7 A medicinal substance or drug. .²8 Modesty. .²9 Bell-metal, brass or gold; <ls>Rām. 7</ls>. .²10 Spirituous liquor. .²11 A wager, stake. .²12 Anointing, plastering. .²13 An ointment. .²14 The animal-dye, lac. .²15 Extract, gum. .²16 A cow; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²17 A verse from the Ṛgveda. द्रव्यशब्दश्छन्दोगैरृक्षु आचरितः . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 7. 2. 14</ls>.
